snippet.title: Rökvale — Four heroes, one tower and a boss with no mercy | Medieval idle RPG
snippet.description:
Four heroes. One tower. And a boss that shows no mercy.

Rökvale is a medieval pixel-art idle RPG made in Brazil. Your party climbs the Tower floor by floor — and you set it all up: each hero's skill bar, the strategy, the potion and the elixir. On the boss floor, the MVP brings earthquakes, minions and rage, and that's where the best drops in the game live. The Tower gets stronger every floor: more levels, better refines, the right element, and the rematch.

The Tower opens at level 50. Free open Alpha Test on PC and Android.

🎮 Play for free: https://rokvale.com.br
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/u8d3ukMtd
🔗 All links: https://rokvale.com.br/links

#rokvale #idlerpg #pixelart
